purpose: Machine-readable witness for authoritative local and regional seat geometry when the Parliament WAF blocks direct CI retrieval.
acquisition_note: Direct CI retrieval of the official Parliament pages returned HTTP 403. The failure is retained in geometry_2026_probe.json. The local rows are transcribed from the official Parliament current electoral-map rendering and its official French numerical table. Regional magnitudes are independently fixed by Article 1 of the SGG consolidated Organic Law 27.11.

sources.role: Current official Parliament map confirms the 92 local constituency rows and local seat magnitudes.
sources.retrieval_route: official page rendered by search index; direct runner access blocked by WAF

legal_watch.rule: A superseding decree or official 2026 geometry publication creates a new witness and certificate version. No prior forecast is overwritten.
